title: Software Tester / QA Engineer
description: Experience: 3–6 Years Education: B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent Work Location: On-site Industry: Defence Technology | Surveillance | AI | Real-Time Video Systems Job Description We are looking for an experienced Software Tester / QA Engineer to validate an integrated Surveillance & Command System involving real-time EO/IR video feeds, AI-based detection overlays, geospatial maps, alerts, and operator workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in functional, regression, negative, exploratory, and performance/soak testing of complex web and backend applications. Experience with video streaming, AI/ML products, real-time systems, or multi-sensor platforms will be highly preferred. You will be responsible for identifying critical issues before deployment, validating end-to-end system behavior, and ensuring product reliability under realistic operational conditions. Key Responsibilities Execute release test plans across edge agents, central backend systems, and operator-facing web applications. Validate multi-feed EO/IR video, synchronization, AI overlays, confidence thresholds, object tracking, and playback/replay functionality. Perform functional, regression, exploratory, negative, and soak testing. Validate REST APIs and React-based operator interfaces, including live video, maps, alerts, reports, settings, and authentication. Test failure scenarios such as UDP packet loss, delayed camera connections, WebRTC reconnections, GPU overload, and AI engine failures. Maintain golden video clips and scenario-based test suites for validating model and sensor-fusion changes. Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual results, logs, screenshots, and video evidence. Perform regression testing after software, AI model, configuration, and engine updates. Coordinate with developers, system engineers, and operators during integration and acceptance testing. Prepare test reports and evidence packages to support certification and release readiness. Required Skills & Experience 3–6 years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance for complex web and backend applications. Strong understanding of manual testing, exploratory testing, regression testing, and test case design. Experience in REST API testing using Postman or Insomnia. Experience testing React-based web applications and browser-based operator interfaces. Exposure to real-time video streaming, AI/ML applications, video analytics, or multi-sensor systems. Understanding of video synchronization, detection overlays, object classification, tracking behavior, and confidence thresholds. Experience designing regression scenarios and maintaining test suites for frequently changing applications. Knowledge of negative testing, network failure simulation, and long-duration soak testing. Basic scripting knowledge in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Familiarity with Git, browser DevTools, test management tools, and screen/video capture utilities. Ability to troubleshoot issues across browsers, desktop GPUs, edge devices, and different network environments. Good to Have Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Jest, or Vitest. Exposure to NVIDIA Jetson or other edge computing platforms. Experience with WebRTC, UDP, RTSP, or other video streaming technologies.
